observed_behavior: A reviewed requirementless inspection gate could not publish its canonical assessment without inventing new work and unrelated requirement/UAT updates.
expected_behavior: The coordinator can persist an existing-obligation assessment checkpoint and referenced plan evidence without a new task or source commit.
causal_mechanism: Discovery validation required a nonempty task list and requirement/UAT updates for every PM transition. Restricting the new assessment mode by task-list emptiness alone also allowed an identical existing task to bypass coordinator-only certificate publication.

anti_pattern.structural_description: Lifecycle authorization and required documents inferred from caller-supplied task-list shape instead of the canonical transition.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: An assessment has no newly discovered task, while an identical existing task is a no-op and does not prove new work or authorize certification.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Only the coordinator publishes canonical certificates; an existing assessment retains scope and changes only its checkpoint and referenced plan evidence.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Validate canonical acceptance and authorize actual appended certificate records or checkpoint certificate acceptance, including reaccepted historical certificates, independently of task list; permit coordinator empty-task assessment with unchanged scope.

applicability_conditions: The queue serializes both new-work discovery and existing-obligation assessment publication.
known_non_matches: New-work discovery still requires its actual requirement/UAT/plan reconciliation.
confirmation_evidence: Real PostgreSQL fixture with requirementless OBL-7 reproduces nonempty-task rejection.
Adding an identical existing requirement-backed task reproduced coordinator-authority bypass.
Explicit invalidation followed by worker reacceptance of the same certificate is rejected despite unchanged certificate count; coordinator reassessment passes.
regression_proofs: tests/swarm-queue.integration.test.ts: inspection-only gate discharges with reviewed canonical source evidence and no invented execution receipt
